meta.title: Free invoice, quotation and receipt templates · Clafina
meta.description: Print a clean invoice, quotation or receipt, or save it as a PDF. When you are ready, make them in Clafina and they post to your books.

hero.title: An invoice, a quotation and a receipt, ready to print.
hero.lede: Each one has what a customer expects to see: who it is from, who it is to, a number, a date, the lines, the tax and the total.

howTo: Choose the template you need and press Print or save as PDF.
In the print window, choose a printer, or Save as PDF to email it.
Use your own business name, the customer's details, a new number for each one, and your own lines and tax.
When you would rather not do it by hand, make it in Clafina: the number, tax and totals are done for you, and it posts to your books.

templates.title: Invoice
templates.body: What a customer owes you, with when it is due.
templates.note: Due in 14 days. Pay by bank transfer and put the invoice number in the reference.

templates.title: Quotation
templates.body: A price you offer before the customer agrees to buy.
templates.note: Valid for 30 days. Prices include fitting in Lagos.

templates.title: Receipt
templates.body: Proof that a customer has paid you.
templates.note: Received with thanks by bank transfer.
